scope: v0.4 configured ordinary application-log inventory, per-source occupancy history and Root-only bounded synchronous manual cleanup. This is not complete PowerX storage governance, automatic enforcement or production acceptance.

implementation.discovery: Actual configured ordinary log basenames and native rotated names only; unrelated parent-directory files excluded. Enabled Agent debug/audit directories and local media registered for observation. Coverage explicitly lists disconnected, disabled and platform-inapplicable resource kinds.
implementation.history: Every registered source receives optional allocated/deduplicated bytes, files, state, problem and private-definition fingerprint in new samples; old samples remain unknown. Net change only for compatible complete observations within 10 minutes; not gross ingress, deletion volume or R95.

manual_cleanup.authorization: Human Root user JWT only; no API Key, STS, service_actor or caller-supplied path/proxy fields. Preview binds instance, environment, actor, source identity, policy revision and expiry.
manual_cleanup.protection: Only recognized sealed native rotations; active and latest generation protected, plus recent modifications, unknown names, symlinks, hardlinks, nonregular files and unsafe ownership/modes. Recheck inode/device/size/blocks/mtime/ctime before unlink.
manual_cleanup.cooperation: Native mill/compression and manual batches use the same directory-inode flock; no lock file, extra timer or change to max_age/max_backups/max_size. Native async mill receives a trigger-time clock snapshot.
manual_cleanup.journal: Persist executing, then each deletion intention before unlink, then each result. CAS serializes record writes. Replays never delete again; an interrupted executing record becomes unconfirmed. Counts are only confirmed removals; reclaimed_bytes stays null.
manual_cleanup.gates: Legacy generic retention enabled blocks execution. Production/staging and resources requiring verified archives remain preview-only pending archive verification.
manual_cleanup.ui: Existing native policy and direct preview are primary; host budget is not required. Generic planning is advanced and does not activate cleanup. Confirmation modal plus independent GET readback, manual record detail and retained context; no periodic status polling.

implementation.metadata_bounds: Per instance latest 100 records listed; admission cap 2000, preview/terminal records older 30 days may be pruned on new preview. Unconfirmed/executing intentions never automatically removed.

native.database: Agent-owned temporary PostgreSQL, Unix socket only, fsync disabled only in disposable fixture; not user database
checks: temporary-file preview, actual removal and durable readback
legacy policy and revision change gates
expiry, actor and production archive gates
failure after unlink remains unknown and cannot reexecute
additive resource histories and changed definitions
idempotent four-table scoped migration preserving business sentinel

local_readonly_inventory.boundary: In-process service with actual local configuration, filesystem and database. No listener, worker, capture, draft save or cleanup. Not the existing running Core HTTP/browser.

frontend_unit.includes: Lost POST response followed by confirmed canonical readback; no duplicate execute; unconfirmed remains unknown; existing draft/scope regressions.

browser.boundary: Actual isolated Nuxt artifact and API client with controlled API fixtures, not live provider or user-host cleanup.
checks: coverage statuses and native defaults without host budget
single confirmed execution and independent record readback
per-resource net change and legacy unknown values
section/source context retained and no idle requests

capability_check.boundary: Four explicit Root host-control route ignores added; not a delegated Framework capability. No new service binding or capability seed.

validation.contracts_and_locales: OpenAPI 0.4.0 internal references validated; 261 storageGov leaves match across zh/en/ja/ko; upgrade registry check and git diff --check passed.

full_typecheck.note: Bare vue-tsc against root files=[] project references is not accepted as application typecheck proof.
